rules.applicable_when: any deck with a quantitative main metric (e.g. speedup, energy efficiency) and ≥2 method chapters

rules.applicable_when: any deck with a cover title containing a core technical thesis

extraction_notes: batch 含 1 个 deck (华为2012报告-大模型推理软硬件协同优化,128 页),典型 research_report 长 deck,五层次方法框架清晰、代表工作 8+ 项。抽出的规则聚焦此类多方法长 deck 中反复出现的强模式:框架图跨章复用、章末量化 summary、主 anchor/主指标高频重复、代表工作四段模板、baseline 对比强制。因 batch 只有 1 deck,estimated_hit_rate 均为 1.0,后续 batch 需验证 universal 性。
